fire.name: Fireproof
fire.twist: Fireproof. Everything here was built to take your fire and shrug.

physical.name: Stone-skinned
physical.twist: Stone-skinned. Blades and fists find no purchase here.

displacement.name: Rooted
displacement.twist: Rooted. Nothing here can be pushed, pulled or swapped.

defense.name: Piercing
defense.twist: Piercing. Attacks here ignore shields, wards and taunts.

fire: You rely on fire. How quaint.
{share} of the pain you deal is fire. I keep count. I'm building something that doesn't burn.
Fire, fire, fire. Do you know any other words?
physical: You hit things. Hard, and often. {share} of it with steel and fists. I'll find you something harder.
All that striking. I'm growing stone that strikes back.
Brute force. Let's see it against something that doesn't bruise.
displacement: You push my pieces around my board. I'm planting ones with roots.
Shove, pull, swap. Clever. I'm making things that won't be moved.
You treat my creatures like furniture. The next room's furniture is bolted down.
defense: Shields, wards, taunts. You hide well. I'm sharpening something.
You've learned to take a hit. I'm teaching mine to go around.
So much bracing. The next ones won't knock first.

fire: I built this for you. Let's see your fire now.
Go on. Burn something. I'll wait.
Fireproof, every one. The prize is worth it, if you can change.
physical: Stone, all the way down. Hit it. I dare you.
This room is harder than your arms. The reward is too.
Made for you. Bring something besides a blade.
displacement: Rooted, every one of them. Push. Go on.
Nothing here moves unless I say so.
A board you can't rearrange. What else do you have?
defense: Your shields won't help here. Neither will your taunts.
These don't fall for tricks. They go straight for the soft parts.
Hide, if you like. They'll find you anyway.

defeat: Not yet. I'm not finished with you.
Falling is allowed. Leaving is not.
reclaim: You cleared {zone}. I didn't like it empty.
Did you think {zone} would stay quiet? I've refilled it.
counterWin: Fine. Take your prize. I'll remember this.
Good. You're more interesting when you change.
firstZone: Out of the Antechamber at last. Everything past here, I'm making up as you go.
Welcome to the rest of me.
